name: Ring of the Lion
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Price 47,600 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring grants a +4 morale bonus to saving throws vs. fear effects. It also grants the wearer a sonic attack as per the shout spell 3/day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Spells shout, remove fear; Cost 23,800 gp

Identification DC 22
